system.traits: Brace, Deadly, Exotic, Keen, Versatile P
system.description:
This formidable two-handed weapon boasts an impressive length, featuring a slender yet wickedly sharp 4-foot-long blade at one end. Predominantly employed by ground troops, it is specifically designed for launching attacks against mounted warriors, providing a strategic advantage on the battlefield.

Brace: If you use a Ready action to attack a mounted target with this weapon, your attack gains a +2-circumstance bonus and inflicts an additional die of base damage on a successful hit.

Automated (TRG Prime 3.668.1): a Strike made through Ready against a mounted target gains +2 circumstance and one more die of base damage.

Traits as printed: Brace, Deadly, Keen, Versatile P.
